select se.id, se.uid, se.lecture_id, se.total, se.remain, se.create_time, se.update_time, se.is_deleted, case when up.real_name is not null and up.real_name != '' then up.real_name when up.nick_name is not null and up.nick_name != '' then up.nick_name else ui.user_name end as student_name, ui.phone, l.name as lecture_name, l.time as lecture_time, l.location, COALESCE(sr.shared_count, 0) as shared_count from student_enrollment se left join user_info ui on ui.id = se.uid left join wx_user_profile up on up.uid = ui.id left join lectures l on l.id = se.lecture_id left join ( select source_uid, lecture_id, sum(count) as shared_count from student_enrollment_share_record group by source_uid, lecture_id ) sr on sr.source_uid = se.uid and sr.lecture_id = se.lecture_id

select se.id, se.uid, case when up.real_name is not null and up.real_name != '' then up.real_name when up.nick_name is not null and up.nick_name != '' then up.nick_name else ui.user_name end as student_name, ui.phone, se.lecture_id, l.name as lecture_name, l.time as lecture_time, l.end_date, l.location, se.total, se.remain, greatest(COALESCE(se.total, 0) - COALESCE(se.remain, 0), 0) as used_count, COALESCE(sr.shared_count, 0) as shared_count, COALESCE(se.remain, 0) as available_share_count, se.create_time, se.update_time from student_enrollment se left join user_info ui on ui.id = se.uid left join wx_user_profile up on up.uid = ui.id left join lectures l on l.id = se.lecture_id left join ( select source_uid, lecture_id, sum(count) as shared_count from student_enrollment_share_record group by source_uid, lecture_id ) sr on sr.source_uid = se.uid and sr.lecture_id = se.lecture_id where se.uid = #{uid} and se.is_deleted = 0 order by l.name asc, se.create_time desc, se.id desc
